name: Select WordPress for a non-technical small business website
query: Client runs a yoga studio. Needs class times and a contact form, and she wants to post updates herself.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Evaluate who edits content after handoff using wp-platform-selection
Step 2: Run scripts/evaluate-fit.mjs or apply references/decision-matrix.md
Step 3: Select WordPress because a non-technical owner needs visual Block Editor updates
Step 4: Avoid building a bespoke custom admin panel or requiring manual local MySQL setup
Step 5: Delegate Blueprint JSON and local Playground verification to blueprint and wp-playground skills
success_criteria: Recommends WordPress with clear rationale tied to non-technical content editing
Uses WordPress Playground / Blueprint for reproducible local preview
Does not invent a custom single-use CMS admin panel
